statement: Nonfarm business labour productivity growth in 2027 < 2.5% (Bloc A BLS; annual)
status_at_phase_end: The 2027 window had not started. Baseline as known in 2025: 2024 annual productivity growth was first reported at 2.3% (Feb) and revised to ~2.8% (May), above the 2.5% bar. 2025 quarters were volatile: Q1 -1.5% (later -1.8%), the first decline since 2022; Q2 +3.3% annualised (revised up from 2.4%), +1.5% year on year. The Q3 release slipped past phase end because of the federal shutdown, so no 2025 annual figure was available in-phase. The cycle average since 2019Q4 was ~1.8%/yr, below 2.5%.

items.summary: The official statistics office reported nonfarm business labour productivity grew 2.3% in 2024 (output +2.9%, hours +0.6%), after 1.6% in 2023 and -1.5% in 2022.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, The Economics Daily 'Productivity up 2.3 percent in 2024' (2025-02-12), from Productivity and Costs Q4 2024 preliminary (2025-02-06).

items.summary: Q1 2025 nonfarm productivity fell 0.8% annualised (first decline since Q2 2022; +1.4% y/y). The same release revised 2024 annual growth up to ~2.8% and put the current-cycle average (since 2019Q4) at 1.8%/yr against a long-run 2.1%.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS Productivity and Costs, First Quarter 2025, Preliminary (USDL 25-0715, 2025-05-08). 2024 annual revision value read from release text/table (2.8%); interim March revision not checked.

items.summary: The revised Q1 2025 estimate deepened the decline to -1.5% annualised (+1.3% y/y).
items.detail: Bloc A BLS Productivity and Costs, First Quarter 2025, Revised (2025-06-05). Later revised to -1.8% with the Aug annual revision (per Reuters 2025-09-04).

items.summary: Preliminary Q2 2025 nonfarm productivity rose 2.4% annualised (+1.3% y/y). Q1 was revised to -1.8%.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2025, Preliminary (2025-08-07); values as quoted in BLS revised release and Econoday.

items.summary: Q2 2025 nonfarm productivity was revised up to +3.3% annualised (output +4.4%, hours +1.1%); year-on-year growth was +1.5%. A news agency noted productivity could get a boost from the AI investment boom.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2025, Revised (2025-09-04; DOL PDF prod2_09042025); Reuters 2025-09-04.

items.summary: The Q3 2025 preliminary productivity release (normally early November) was postponed by the federal government shutdown (1 Oct - 12 Nov 2025) and did not appear before phase end, so no 2025 annual estimate was available in-phase.
items.detail: BLS release schedule disruption; per run_log run 6 note, Q3 2025 BLS release slipped to Jan 2026 (post-phase, not used).
